detection_note: Incident declared 2026-01-08 18:19 UTC when the release had reached ~90% of servers.
notes: 1.1.1.1 release reordered CNAMEs in responses, breaking clients expecting CNAME first; impact start not stated, ended 19:55 UTC.

title: Route leak incident on January 22, 2026
root_cause_quote: On January 22, 2026, an automated routing policy configuration error caused us to leak some Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) prefixes unintentionally from a router at our data center in Miami, Florida.
detection_note: 20:40 UTC network team begins investigating unintended route advertisements from Miami (impact began 20:25).
notes: IPv6 BGP route leak from Miami router via policy automation; 25 min, affected external networks too.

title: Cloudflare outage on February 20, 2026
root_cause_quote: This issue was caused by a change that Cloudflare made to how our network manages IP addresses onboarded through the BYOIP pipeline. This change caused Cloudflare to unintentionally withdraw customer prefixes.
detection_note: We were able to detect impact on one.one.one.one and revert the impacting change before more prefixes were impacted.
notes: New automated BYOIP cleanup sub-task misread empty pending_delete flag, withdrawing ~1,100 prefixes; 6h07m incl. restoring configs.

title: GitHub Actions outage after routine deployment exhausted capacity
root_cause_quote: The affected actions services were running close to their capacity and concurrency limits. A routine deployment that briefly reduced the number of running pods was enough to exhaust available headroom.
detection_note: We declared a public incident, identified the triggering deployment, and rolled it back to confirm its contents were not the cause.
notes: Deployment contents not at fault; pod replacement during rollout cut capacity; cascade incl. DNS errors; latent job-assignment bug slowed recovery.

title: Datacenter load balancer overload degrading auth, issues and PRs
root_cause_quote: A new peak in traffic pushed one datacenter’s load balancers past their limits. A service-mesh sidecar reached its concurrency limit and did not scale up.
detection_note: Automated monitoring detects the elevated errors and an incident is opened
notes: Latent client retry bug amplified auth traffic and slowed recovery.

title: Copilot cloud agent task status delays from provider database outage
root_cause_quote: One region of that database suffered a provider-side outage, and the calls that read and write task status in the affected region began failing and running slow.
detection_note: On-call engineers were paged, opened an incident, and traced the errors to the affected database region.
notes: Managed cloud database regional outage; storage configuration slowed failover.

title: GitHub Actions run-start failures from database saturation
root_cause_quote: A burst of incoming events arrived on top of an already-high load and pushed the database past its tipping point. Query times climbed, and the database primary saturated.
notes: No automatic circuit breaker; throttling applied manually.

title: Copilot Kimi K3 model failures from upstream provider
root_cause_quote: That provider had a serving degradation that caused a large share of Kimi K3 requests to fail with errors.
detection_note: Within a few minutes, monitoring flagged the elevated errors and we began investigating.
notes: Upstream model provider degradation; other models unaffected.

title: Data-resident Enterprise Cloud outage from automated metadata change
root_cause_quote: An automated infrastructure metadata process changed a runtime configuration value across virtual machines in these affected environments. A safeguard that normally prevents this value from changing on running machines did not apply to this update. The incorrect value disrupted service discovery and left traffic routers without available backends.
detection_note: Our automated monitoring detected elevated 5xx errors within approximately 19 minutes of the first impact.
notes: Recovery slow: values corrected per machine; a component ran out of memory during recovery.

title: GitHub Actions hosted runner provisioning failures
root_cause_quote: The incident was caused by an unhealthy state in a backend data service responsible for provisioning hosted runners, preventing runner acquisition for a subset of workloads. The shard serving the highest-volume runner workload became overloaded and could not synchronize reliably across regions, preventing runner acquisition for affected workloads.
notes: Overloaded shard in backend data replication service; no change named.

title: GitHub MCP Server web_search tool failures
root_cause_quote: This was caused by degradation at an upstream web search provider.
notes: Header says 3h07m; body window 08:50-09:50 UTC.

title: Internal DNS reconfiguration disrupted service discovery
root_cause_quote: At 17:50 UTC, a database connectivity issue affected our internal DNS control plane. The resulting incomplete data was incorrectly interpreted by automated reconfiguration of DNS servers across the fleet and disrupted internal service discovery.
detection_note: Automated monitoring detected customer impact within approximately one minute.
notes: Initiator was a DB connectivity issue; automation acting on incomplete data was the flaw. Arguably config_change.

title: GitHub Actions runner connectivity loss from expired certificate
root_cause_quote: The incident was caused by a certificate lifecycle management failure in a subset of internal services, resulting in an SSL certificate expiration that disrupted runner connectivity.
detection_note: while a replacement was generated, it was not automatically deployed on receiving an automated alert
notes: Certificate relied on manual deployment; fixed by rotation.

title: SSH authentication rejections from infrastructure change regression
root_cause_quote: This was due to a regression introduced during an unrelated internal infrastructure change.
notes: Report does not say whether the change was code or config; mitigated by revert.

title: Pull request creation failures after Vitess backfill cancellation
root_cause_quote: The backfill Vitess command encountered errors and increased VReplication lag, and the workflow was canceled at 19:17 UTC. The cancellation executed a misunderstood Vitess codepath that dropped the backing table to the target keyspace, leaving a non-existent reference that resulted in errors creating pull requests.
notes: Database backfill operation; cancellation dropped a table.

title: GitHub Actions degradation during Redis cluster config change
root_cause_quote: During a planned availability-related configuration change on a critical-path Redis cluster for Actions, one participating region was left in a degraded state. Separately, an independent capacity operation temporarily removed another region from the cluster and redirected its traffic to the degraded region.
notes: Two periods; second caused by Redis node failures in scaling region during mitigation.

title: Copilot code review failures from newly released dependency
root_cause_quote: The issue was caused by a newly released dependency used by the Copilot code review processing workflow. The release introduced an incompatibility with the runtime environment. Because the workflow automatically consumed the latest release, the incompatible version was picked up without sufficient compatibility validation and caused review processing to fail.
notes: Unpinned dependency auto-consumed latest release.

title: Signed-out 504 errors from abusive anonymous traffic
root_cause_quote: The issue was caused by a significant increase in abusive, automated anonymous traffic to specific github.com endpoints.
notes: Mitigated with targeted blocks at load balancer and app layers.

title: API authentication failures after memcached proxy rollout
root_cause_quote: A memcached proxy service, rollout to our internal API infrastructure caused our authentication service to pick up an incorrect host configuration, leading to intermittent authentication lookup failures.
notes: Rollout picked up wrong host config; fixed by config change. Could be read as code_deploy.

title: Copilot Opus 4.8 model degraded from upstream provider
root_cause_quote: This was caused by an issue with an upstream model provider.
notes: Other models unaffected.

title: Copilot frontier models unavailable after invalid configuration change
root_cause_quote: This was due to a configuration change that our production system deemed invalid.
notes: Mitigated by reverting the configuration change.

title: Background job service delays from hypervisor issues and traffic spike
root_cause_quote: The issue was caused by underlying hypervisor issues and an incoming traffic spike, causing service timeouts which led to a connection storm and continual rebalances.
notes: Mitigated by replacing the impacted node; traffic spike was a co-factor.

title: Copilot GPT models degraded from upstream Responses API issue
root_cause_quote: the GitHub Copilot service was degraded due to an issue with the Responses API of an upstream provider affecting the GPT-5.2, GPT-5.3-Codex, GPT-5.4, and GPT-5.5 models.
notes: Traffic shifted away from affected models.

title: GitHub Actions outage after service account wrongly suspended
root_cause_quote: This was caused by our automated account review system incorrectly suspending the service account used by GitHub Actions to authenticate workflow runs and download actions.
notes: Automated account-review system flaw; no recent change named. Credential disabled, not expired.

title: GitHub Actions failures during planned infrastructure failover
root_cause_quote: The incident was triggered by a planned failover of supporting infrastructure used by GitHub Actions. During that operation, an automated service discovery update did not propagate correctly, which caused traffic to be routed incorrectly and increased request timeouts in a core dependency for workflow orchestration.
notes: Responders manually corrected service discovery routing.

title: Copilot agent sessions delayed by database migration replication lag
root_cause_quote: The issue was caused by follow-up recovery work from a separate pull request incident. As part of that recovery, we ran a large database migration, which caused replication delays on several replica hosts.
notes: Safeguards throttled writes on replication lag, delaying PR background events.

title: Pull request review thread creation failures from 32-bit key exhaustion
root_cause_quote: This incident was caused by a 32-bit integer key reaching its maximum value in a Vitess lookup table used during pull request thread creation. The primary table was migrated to a 64-bit integer key, but the Vitess lookup table remained 32-bit.
notes: Integer ID space exhaustion; earlier incomplete migration left lookup table 32-bit.

title: Copilot cloud agent sessions down after network routing config change
root_cause_quote: The issue was caused by a configuration change to the service’s network routing that inadvertently removed the ingress path for the service.
notes: Reverted at 11:13 UTC.
